scripts.test: pnpm --filter shadcn-lint-angular run build && pnpm --filter shadcn-lint-angular run test
scripts.corpus: pnpm --filter shadcn-lint-angular run build && pnpm --filter evals run corpus
scripts.corpus:check: pnpm --filter shadcn-lint-angular run build && pnpm --filter evals run corpus:check
scripts.evals: pnpm --filter shadcn-lint-angular run build && pnpm --filter evals run run
scripts.release: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run corpus:check && changeset publish
